## Description {#details}

<p>This pass exposes codegen information to IR-level passes.</p>


<p>Every transformation that uses codegen information is broken into three parts:</p>


<ol class="doxyList" type="1">
<li>The IR-level analysis pass.</li>
<li>The IR-level transformation interface which provides the needed information.</li>
<li>Codegen-level implementation which uses target-specific hooks.</li>
</ol>

<p>This file defines #2, which is the interface that IR-level transformations use for querying the codegen.</p>
